items.exampleEn: I was surprised to see him there.
items.exampleZh: 在那裡看到他，我很驚訝。

items.exampleEn: She has a talent for music.
My sister is very creative. She makes her own clothes.
items.exampleZh: 我姊姊很有創意，她都自己做衣服。

items.exampleEn: It's an honor to meet you.
We heard a scream from the next room.
items.exampleZh: 我們聽到隔壁房間傳來一聲尖叫。

items.exampleEn: The news was a big shock to everyone.
items.exampleZh: 這個消息讓大家非常震驚。

items.sentenceZh: 很可惜，整個週末都在下雨。

items.audioEn: I was surprised when my classmates gave me a birthday cake.
items.audioZh: 同學送我生日蛋糕時，我很驚訝。

items.sentenceZh: 每個人都有特別的天分。

items.sentenceEn: It was a great honor for me.
items.sentenceZh: 這對我來說是莫大的榮幸。

items.stemEn: Nobody thought he could win, so everyone was ____ when he won.
items.stemZh: 沒人想到他會贏，所以他贏的時候大家都很驚訝。

items.passageEn: Last month, our school had an art contest. Jenny, a quiet girl, painted a picture of her grandmother for the contest. When the teacher read the winner's name, we heard a scream. It was Jenny! The news was a big shock to her, because she never thought she had any talent. Unfortunately, her parents were not there. But her teacher was not surprised. "You are very creative," he said.
items.passageZh: 上個月，我們學校舉辦了一場美術比賽。安靜的女孩 Jenny 為比賽畫了一幅她奶奶的畫像。老師唸出得獎者名字的時候，我們聽到一聲尖叫——是 Jenny！這個消息讓她非常震驚，因為她從沒想過自己有什麼天分。可惜她爸媽不在場。不過她的老師一點也不驚訝，他說：「妳非常有創意。」

questions.questionZh: 老師唸出得獎者名字時發生了什麼事？
options: 大家都很安靜地離開了教室
她從沒想過自己有天分
她的畫在比賽前被弄壞了

referenceEn: I like his personality very much.
rubricZh: 「很喜歡」可寫例如 really like、like … very much、love

items.instructionZh: 用 surprised 造一個句子，說說一件讓你很驚訝的事。
referenceEn: I was surprised to get a letter from my old teacher.
I was surprised when my friend called me from Japan.
rubricZh: 可寫例如 surprised to＋原形動詞（surprised to get）、surprised when＋子句
過去的事用過去式（例如 was）
